environment: Windows VM in UTM, interactive user session 1
scope: Synthetic XCSVSP2 project only, Network 254, CNI 127.0.0.1:1, one RELDN8SP database unit at address 9

original_help.instruction: C-Bus Projects > Project > Network > Units in Database toolbar, or right-click the Units in Database node or window

observed_steps: Selected the XCSVSP2 Units node; Toolkit displayed Units in Database (1) - XCSVSP2 and the RELDN8SP row at address 009.
Right-clicked that Units node; its context menu showed an enabled Document Database action.
Invoked Document Database; Toolkit opened CSV Selection with checked column rows.
Accepted the current column selection; Toolkit opened a native Windows Save As dialog with CSV Files (*.csv) selected.

outcome.reason: Filename entry through UTM computer input became corrupt; the UTM guest-agent RPC later timed out, so no reliable output path or file could be verified.
